## Summary
<!-- Что и зачем в 1-3 предложениях -->

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Money-impacting change (требует special checklist)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Refactor (no business logic change)

## Linked issues / RFC / ADR / Decision
- Closes #
- RFC: docs/rfc/
- ADR: docs/adr/
- Decision: DEC-XXX in docs/decision-board.md

## Money / Custody / Risk impact
- [ ] Touches ledger / balances / fees / withdrawals / risk / signing / KYC / AML
- [ ] Founder approval received (reference: )
- [ ] Idempotency considered
- [ ] Audit log added
- [ ] Reconciliation impact reviewed

## Tests
- [ ] Unit tests added
- [ ] Integration tests added
- [ ] E2E tests added (если applicable)
- [ ] Property tests for invariants
- [ ] Manual test plan attached

## Security
- [ ] No new secrets added (or properly stored in vault)
- [ ] No PII in logs
- [ ] Authn / Authz checks
- [ ] No forbidden phrases (guaranteed profit etc)
- [ ] Static checks pass (Semgrep, Gitleaks)

## Documentation
- [ ] /docs updated
- [ ] API spec updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Runbook updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Changelog entry added

## Rollout
- [ ] Feature flag added (if applicable)
- [ ] Migration plan documented
- [ ] Rollback plan documented
- [ ] Canary / shadow strategy described

## Reviewers checklist
- [ ] CODEOWNERS satisfied
- [ ] CI checks green
- [ ] No open SEV-1/2 incidents
- [ ] No critical reconciliation errors
